dataList.name: [Season 8] 3★ Guarantee Decaextraction Ticket
dataList.desc: Can be used to perform 10 extractions where one 3★ Identity from [Season 8] is guaranteed to appear.
dataList.flavor: A special ticket with a mark on it. It can extract an Identity from a world of unlikely possibilities with certainty. The paper is fiercely beating и pulsing.

dataList.name: [Season 8] Egoshard Crate
dataList.desc: Open to receive 1-3 Egoshards of random Sinners.
dataList.flavor:
Egoshards were randomly harvested и stored in these boxes. Its contents are a mystery.
Когда you hold one in a quiet place, you can hear small fusses.

dataList.name: [Season 8] Nominable Egoshard Crate
dataList.desc: Open to receive 1-3 Egoshards of a Sinner of choice.
dataList.flavor:
A crate that yields Egoshards of a Sinner you choose.
According to Faust, the crate's content is determined один раз the manager makes their decision.

dataList.desc: 재화 등장 확률 상세 표시용(name 만 번역해주세요)

dataList.name: [Season 8] Yi Sang’s Egoshard
dataList.desc: Used for purchasing Yi Sang’s Айдишки, Э.Г.О, и Thread from the Dispenser.
dataList.flavor:
Fleeting moments from any point within the Sinner’s lifetime, condensed в physical form. The shards float in the air.
Possibilities are transient things; they drift in the realm of uncertainty unless seized.

dataList.name: Season 8 Uptie & Threadspinning only Shard (Universal)
dataList.desc: Can be used to Uptie Айдишки и Threadspin Э.Г.О для всех балбесов.
dataList.flavor:
A universal shard that can be used to Uptie или Threadspin Айдишки & Э.Г.О для всех балбесов.
However, these shards cannot be used to extract Айдишки или Э.Г.О, no matter how many of these shards one collects.
'These shards are products of our research в the omnitransformative nature of Golden Boughs; it can be used to fill any fathoms или worlds of mirrors. Huh? Extractions? Of course not. Its one-size-fits-все-worlds nature would mean that it obviously cannot have been made *for* any specific world, right? - LCA Mirror World Observatorium Department Chief Researcher'
